primary_sources.title: Understanding the Detrimental Class-level Effects of Data Augmentation
primary_sources.read_scope: Introduction, related work, evaluation setup, sections5-6 with augmentation-induced class confusion and source-class interventions; RandAugment extension explicitly stated.
primary_sources.finding: Average improvement can coexist with class harms; class-distribution overlap, ambiguous labels and false-positive destination classes already studied.
primary_sources.boundary: Current finite-cache loss accounting is not a new harm mechanism or class-conditional algorithm; no reannotation/causal training intervention.

primary_sources.title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
primary_sources.finding: Partial RandAugment/mixing augmentation compared via AUC and ECE on two pretrained EfficientNets with imbalanced melanoma labels; accuracy/ranking versus calibration can move differently.
primary_sources.boundary: This project uses fixed37-class Pet predictions, NLL/correctness-group accounting; no medical claim, calibration certification or new method.

primary_sources.title: On the Reproducibility of Neural Network Predictions
primary_sources.finding: Training randomness can produce prediction churn at similar accuracy.
primary_sources.boundary: Within-run epoch stability and two fixed augmentation trajectories do not estimate retraining churn or seed variability.
